baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative i'buduni is followed by the deictic equation hadha siratun mustaqimun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Submissive obedience to the speaker is not merely located beside a sound route; hadha identifies that enacted allegiance with the route itself.

activation_trace.role: The worship-and-submissive-obedience branch supplies the commanded act that the deictic turns into a route.
The straight-road branch gives obedience a traversable directional frame.
The rectitude and evenness branch marks that route as aligned rather than deviant.

changed_reading.before: A command to worship followed by a separate commendation of a path.
changed_reading.after: The commanded obedience is itself presented as the aligned route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus places the service root ع ب د directly beside صراط and مستقيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The road-taming branch of ع ب د resonates materially with the road noun: repeated service can be heard as treading, leveling, and sustaining a course rather than only assenting to one.

activation_trace.role: The branch of making a road tractable supplies the material roadwork image while remaining a form-distant activation of the worship verb.
The road branch receives the service-as-treading image as an actual course.
The support-and-sustenance branch lets enacted service keep the course standing and usable.

changed_reading.before: Worship is an inward posture practiced on a pre-existing path.
changed_reading.after: Worship is also path-making practice: service treads and sustains the course it names.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical path formula first locates the messenger, then the city sequence turns it into a relay: a man moves purposefully, calls others to track the messengers, names them guided, and grounds his own worship in origination and return.

activation_trace.role: The straight-road branch makes the messenger's position the earlier instance of the focus route.
The rectitude branch exactly repeats the focus route's quality.
Tracking trace after trace turns the route into imitable messenger-led movement.
Gentle direction to road and truth confirms that following is oriented rather than merely social.
The repeated worship branch supplies a lived instance of the focus command.
Origination gives the worshiper's movement a source.
Return gives that movement an endpoint.

structural_cues: 36:3-4 places the messenger on the same صراط مستقيم construction later predicated of worship.
36:20-22 sequences purposeful movement, following, guidance, worship, origination, and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula and the movement-following-worship sequence; I infer that the messenger's enacted route mediates the worship command. A live alternative is that these are reinforcing examples without a relay mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is a doctrine named after the worship command.
changed_reading.after: It is a transmissible practice: embodied by the messenger, tracked by followers, and enacted as worship between origin and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding covenant prohibits service to a hostile, crooked rival; the focus imperative supplies the positive allegiance, and the following ayah names mass misdirection and failed rational restraint. Straightness is therefore covenantal resistance to a rival command structure.

activation_trace.role: The preserved covenant branch frames the prohibition and focus imperative as two halves of a binding relation.
The same submissive-service branch establishes Satanic service as the explicit counter-allegiance.
The opposition-and-crookedness branch gives the rival allegiance a geometry contrary to mustaqim.
Crossing the bound and doing wrong makes rival service a hostile breach rather than a neutral option.
Deviation from guidance supplies the realized opposite of the focus route.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance makes straight allegiance an act of bounded discernment.

structural_cues: 36:60 and 36:61 are adjacent antithetical service commands with different objects.
36:62 immediately gives misdirection as the consequence of the prohibited allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant, opposed service objects, crooked opposition, hostility, and misdirection; I infer a transfer-of-allegiance and release-from-hostile-servitude mechanism. The narrower alternative is simply a prohibition followed by a positive command.

changed_reading.before: A freestanding positive summons to worship.
changed_reading.after: The positive half of a covenantal emancipation grammar: refuse hostile servitude and take the allegiance that keeps movement from bending away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deeds leave enduring tracks, bodily earning becomes testimony, and the later path scene depends on eyes and the capacity to move forward or return. The focus's road-taming service branch becomes an embodied, inspectable trajectory.

activation_trace.role: The tractable-road branch anchors the changed reading in service as repeated treading.
A remaining mark that discloses prior action makes one's course recordable.
The earning-limbs branch joins accountable acquisition to the hands-and-feet testimony sequence.
The repeated road is something bodies attempt to race toward, materializing the focus noun.
Literal sight supplies a condition for locating and traversing the route.
Passing onward supplies the forward vector whose loss makes the path unusable.
Return supplies the reverse vector also lost when agency is fixed in place.

structural_cues: 36:65-67 moves from mouth, hands, and feet to eyes and path, then to a body unable to proceed or return.
36:12 records both what people send ahead and the tracks they leave.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistent tracks, bodily testimony, sight, path, and blocked motion; I infer that worship is the trace-making use of bodily agency. A live alternative treats these as separate judgment signs with no practice model.

changed_reading.before: Service only resembles road-making at the lexical level.
changed_reading.after: Service is an embodied trace-making walk: hands and feet enact a trajectory that remains legible and later testifies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun and moon are straight not by moving in geometrically straight lines but by keeping measured courses, stations, order, and non-encroachment. Mustaqim can therefore name faithful fit to an assigned course within a coordinated whole.

activation_trace.role: Rectitude and evenness anchor the cosmic-course analogy in mustaqim.
A running custom or established course makes solar motion patterned rather than arbitrary.
Fit to measure and a proper mean supplies calibrated order.
The negated advance or racing marks non-encroachment between coordinated courses.
The celestial orbit supplies a curved but ordered route.
Swimming or running supplies sustained motion within that route.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 joins destination, measure, lunar stations, non-overtaking, orbit, and continuous motion.
The ordered course is explicitly curved, preventing a merely geometric equation of straightness with linearity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured non-colliding cosmic courses; I map their rule-fidelity onto the focus's rectitude. This is a cross-domain analogy, and the live alternative keeps cosmic order only as a general sign of power.

changed_reading.before: Straight means a geometrically direct moral line.
changed_reading.after: Straight can mean faithfully keeping one's measured course and bounds within a larger created order, even where the course itself curves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Origination and return recur around bodily emergence from graves and re-creation from the first production. The q-w-m resurrection branch turns the focus route into a full temporal axis: created by God, rising through accountable life, and returning to God.

activation_trace.role: The resurrection-and-standing branch anchors the route's endpoint in the focus adjective.
Initial bringing-into-being supplies the route's point of departure.
Return supplies the destination already attached to the worshiper's argument.
Rapid bursting forward from the graves materializes postmortem movement toward the Lord.
Rousing what was still supplies the transition from halted life to standing movement.
Producing a thing anew joins first creation to the possibility of renewed life.
Beginning and precedence mark the first production as the proof for the later one.
The final recurrence of return closes the surah-wide trajectory.

structural_cues: 36:22 and 36:83 bracket the extended argument with return to God.
36:51-53 and 36:77-81 expand that return into bodily rising and re-creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin, repeated return, grave-emergence, and renewed creation; I infer that these give the focus path a temporal vector. The alternative is that resurrection only motivates obedience without defining the path's shape.

changed_reading.before: Straightness describes the quality of present moral conduct.
changed_reading.after: Straightness aligns the whole created trajectory: from divine origination, through worshipful life, to bodily rising and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created livestock sequence moves through human possession, domestication, benefit, and gratitude, then contrasts taken deities that cannot give support. Worship straightens dependence by directing allegiance and thanks toward the actual source of creaturely support.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship anchors the model in the commanded relation of dependence.
The support, subsistence, and sustaining-order branch lets mustaqim describe a dependence that actually holds life up.
Creative bringing-into-being identifies the actual source of the provision chain.
Possession and disposal establish the human-over-animal relation inside the larger chain.
Domestication and facilitation after difficulty make the provided animals serviceable to humans.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver supplies the fitting upward response.
The worshiped-object branch marks the rival placement of dependence.
The denied aid-and-manifest-support branch exposes the rival deities as unable to sustain their dependents.

structural_cues: 36:71-73 sequences creation, possession, domestication, use, benefit, and the demand for gratitude.
36:74-75 immediately reverses expected support: the taken deities cannot aid their worshipers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a provision hierarchy and failed rival support; I infer that dependence should run toward the maker who actually sustains it. The alternative is a narrower gratitude proof with no hierarchy-of-service model.

changed_reading.before: Worship is isolated subjection to a command.
changed_reading.after: Worship is correctly ordered dependence and gratitude, aligning allegiance with the source that truly creates, facilitates, and sustains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it compares a resistible human imperative with the efficacious creative fiat of 36:82. It remains anchored in i'buduni and q-w-m's rising-to-an-affair branch, while 36:82 supplies command, speech, and becoming. Render it only as an analogy of responsive creaturehood, not as a claim that worship is automatic or that the two commands are grammatically identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus imperative calls the creature to rise into service; 36:82 presents the Creator's command as bringing the addressed thing into being.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience supplies the voluntary creaturely answer.
Resolve and rising to an affair lets straightness appear as standing up to answer.
Request and obligation supply the command pole of the analogy.
Uttered speech supplies the direct-address mechanism.
Occurrence and presence supply the realized creative response.

changed_reading.before: The imperative asks for an externally imposed duty.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, worship is the creature's voluntary answer to the commanding speech by which its existence and course are given.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the equal-weight and valuation branches of q-w-m are distant from the surface sense of mustaqim. It remains anchored in that focus inventory and is activated by 36:54's no-wrong and act-for-act recompense. Render it as a juridical or metrological resonance, not as a replacement translation of mustaqim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mustaqim carries a q-w-m branch of equal weight and balanced measure, while 36:54 describes uncompromised recompense.

activation_trace.role: Equal weight and balanced measure supply the focus-side calibration image.
Putting a thing outside its proper place, here negated, supplies the failure that exact rectitude excludes.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies reciprocal calibration.
Intended action supplies the measured input to judgment.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is only spatial or directional rectitude.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also carries exact moral calibration: acts remain in right measure and receive corresponding return without displacement.

strongest_changes: The immediate 36:60-62 frame turns worship into the positive allegiance of a covenant against hostile, crooked servitude.
The 36:3-22 sequence makes the path messenger-embodied, followable, and oriented from origination to return.
The tracks and body-path sequence in 36:12 and 36:65-67 makes service an embodied trajectory that remains inspectable.
The measured celestial courses of 36:38-40 change straightness from mere linearity into faithful fit to an ordered course.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly materialized the focus equation as messenger relay, covenant boundary, bodily track, cosmic course, origin-return axis, and ordered dependence without requiring those mechanisms to collapse into one sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from worship to path passability is inferred from juxtaposed track, body, sight, and motion scenes rather than stated.
The cosmic-course model is a cross-domain analogy and should not erase the ordinary rectitude sense.
The resurrection, creative-command, and equal-weight activations are branch-supported but more form-distant than the primary worship-and-road reading.
